description: The den kit's guards, for any project that loads the den plugin: context budget, board identity and raw-jg guard, uncapped test runs, sleep chains. Load it with claude --plugin-dir <den checkout>/.claude: the guards run from the den checkout, and a missing guard blocks the call.

hooks.command: test -f "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/../scripts/hooks/context-budget.mjs" || { echo "den plugin: guard script missing (context-budget.mjs); load the plugin with claude --plugin-dir <den checkout>/.claude" >&2; exit 2; }; node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/../scripts/hooks/context-budget.mjs"

test -f "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/../scripts/hooks/bash-guard.mjs" || { echo "den plugin: guard script missing (bash-guard.mjs); load the plugin with claude --plugin-dir <den checkout>/.claude" >&2; exit 2; }; node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/../scripts/hooks/bash-guard.mjs"

test -f "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/../mods/test-run-guard/hooks/test-run-guard.mjs" || { echo "den plugin: guard script missing (test-run-guard.mjs); load the plugin with claude --plugin-dir <den checkout>/.claude" >&2; exit 2; }; node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/../mods/test-run-guard/hooks/test-run-guard.mjs"

test -f "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/../mods/sleep-guard/hooks/sleep-guard.mjs" || { echo "den plugin: guard script missing (sleep-guard.mjs); load the plugin with claude --plugin-dir <den checkout>/.claude" >&2; exit 2; }; node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/../mods/sleep-guard/hooks/sleep-guard.mjs"
